summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(str(self)) (prefix test, reference as subject); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()) using node-type-aware equality, inherited by _RDFNamespace; _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). In test/test_namespace.py: added NamespaceMembershipTest covering Namespace prefix positive/negative/self cases, RDFS positive/negative plus plain-string and Literal negatives, and RDF positive. Tests were not run (per instructions), no commits made.
